 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAURABH BANERJEE  ORDER % 12.12.2023 1.

The petitioners, vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973

, seek quashing of FIR No.16/2021 dated 30.04.2021 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Crime (Women) Cell, Nanakpura, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Mediation Settlement dated 06.05.2023 arrived at between the parties before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi.
CRL.M.C. 9106/2023 page 1 of 3
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/12/2023 at 02:22:00 2.

This petition is accompanied by the Mediation Settlement dated 06.05.2023 [Annexure-P-2] and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3.
Petitioner nos.1 to 4 as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of Himanshu And Ors vs The State (Nct Of Delhi) And Anr on 12 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15342605/

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 03.10.2023.

She further affirms the Mediation Settlement dated 06.05.2023 whereby the petitioner no.1 has already paid her a sum of Rs.16,50,000/- and the remaining amount of Rs.5,50,000/- has been handed over to the respondent no. 2 vide DD no.015697 issued on 27.10.2023 [Punjab National Bank] in full and final settlement of all her claims including alimony,
maintenance (present, past and future), stridhan etc.
She states that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

7. In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors. Vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is CRL.M.C. 9106/2023 page 2 of 3 This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/12/2023 at 02:22:00 of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.

8. Accordingly, the petition is allowed and FIR No.16/2021 dated 30.04.2021 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Crime (Women) Cell, Nanakpura, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed.
9. The petition alongwith the pending application stands disposed of.
